transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I’ve been feeling, quietly but pretty persistently, like the best part of my life may already be behind me. I keep thinking that no matter how much I plan or try to be disciplined, I’m not going to get back to feeling like myself.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since the hiking injury—so, a little over three years now. About three years and three months.
During these three years, have you ever had a stretch of more than two months where your mood felt completely back to normal?
No, I haven’t had a stretch like that. It’s been there pretty much continuously since the injury, over three years now.
Before the hiking injury three years ago, had you ever experienced a period of depression in your life?
I’m not sure. I can’t really point to a time before that and say I was depressed.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you used to enjoy doing?

Yes, I think so. I still take care of the basics at home, but I’ve pulled back a lot from mentoring, community events, music gatherings, and making travel plans. My weeks are much smaller than they used to be.
How has your sleep been over these past few years?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep over the years.
How have your energy levels been over these past few years?

I still get up and do the shopping, and I tinker with my projects, but small things wear me out more than they should. Setting up for a mentoring session or walking through a community event can leave me exhausted, and a nap doesn’t really fix it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over this time?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really kept track of my appetite or my weight over that time.
Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it in those terms.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing on things?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any particular problem focusing, but I don’t know that I’ve paid close attention to it.
Have you been struggling with low self-esteem or feeling down on yourself?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed that specifically. I don’t really spend much time thinking about myself that way.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?

Yes, I think so. It’s a quiet feeling, but it’s been hard to shake—the sense that the best part of my life may be behind me, and that no matter how much I plan or try to be disciplined, I’m not going to get back to feeling like myself.
